title: Audio Memo Received Event
description: The inbox watcher observed a new voice memo object in S3 and took ownership of it. Part of the voice memo journey: every stage fact and the agent invocation share correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

memo_id.description: Journey id: uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 's3://holocene-auto/' + s3_key). Also the correlationid of this event and of the agent invocation command, so one correlationid query returns the whole journey.

s3_key.description: Object key of the voice memo in the holocene-auto bucket: inbox/<agent>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<file>.

target_agent_id.description: Agent the memo is addressed to. Parsed from the S3 key path only, never inferred from audio.

content_type.description: Content type guessed from the key extension.

detected_at.description: When the watcher first saw the object (RFC3339).
